outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel b shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image spacing; no plot of averages is present.
Panel c shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating zoom/inset presentation; no plot of averages is present.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast schematic diagram and grayscale micrographs; no plot of averages is present.
Panel e shows schematic color-annotation icons and micrographs/staining images; no plot of averages is present.
Panel f shows a schematic Venn-like diagram and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel separation; no plot of averages is present.
Panel g shows schematic calibration scale diagrams and micrographs with intensity legends; no plot of averages is present.
